prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game ground tile texture atlas for Fingersnap, original cozy top-down woodland RPG. Square 1024x1024 canvas, exactly 4 columns and 4 rows, each tile exactly 256x256 pixels. Fill every tile entirely to its square edges, no gutters, no borders, no labels. All are flat orthographic top-down ground surfaces, NOT perspective, not isometric, no raised objects. Palette rich emerald, deep teal shadows, amber earth, weathered golden stone, crisp pixel-style clustered detail. Row1 tiles: plain emerald grass; emerald grass with sparse tiny blue flowers; dark forest moss; dry amber packed dirt. Row2: golden cobblestone pavement; cracked golden cobblestone with moss; worn shrine flagstones; dark cave gravel. Row3: teal pond water with subtle ripples; shallow teal water with visible pebbles; russet horizontal wood planks; dark russet horizontal wood planks. Row4: dirt path overlay on grass running vertically and reaching top and bottom edges; dirt path overlay on grass running horizontally and reaching left and right edges; dirt crossroads on grass reaching all four edges; dirt junction on grass reaching top left right edges. Tileable ground patterns, matching border colors within each material, no lighting gradient or vignette. Flat game-ready material swatches, no drop shadow, no decorative framing, no text, no UI. Make texture scale coherent across all squares. Do not paint an entire landscape.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent foreground occluder atlas for Fingersnap woodland RPG. Square 1024x1024 canvas. Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual directional walking animation sprite sheet for Fingersnap, original demo adventurer NOT a Habitica asset. Square 1024x1024 canvas, EXACT regular 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 equal 256x256 cells, no grid lines. ONE consistent cute small chibi adventurer with brown short hair, amber scarf, teal tunic, russet boots, small brown backpack. Pixel art deliberately simple 32-pixel-style silhouette expanded cleanly, NOT detailed painting. Top-down three-quarter RPG view. Four cardinal directions by row: row1 faces DOWN toward viewer; row2 faces LEFT; row3 faces RIGHT; row4 faces UP away from viewer, showing backpack. Across every row four WALK CYCLE frames: left foot forward, passing neutral, right foot forward, passing neutral. Arms swing opposite legs. Head costume proportions and colors strictly identical through all frames. Each sprite same scale, centered horizontally in its cell, feet at exactly 80 percent of cell height, no large vertical bobbing, full body never cropped, large transparent margins. Body occupies approx 40 percent of cell width and 60 percent of height. No weapons, no labels, no shadows, no motion lines, no text, no floor, no glow, no checkerboard. Genuine transparent alpha. These are sequential animation frames, not sixteen different character designs. Make direction changes unambiguous and poses small enough to animate smoothly.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game enemy animation atlas for Fingersnap cozy woodland RPG. Landscape 4:3 canvas 1024x768, EXACT regular 4 columns x 3 rows, each cell 256x256, no grid lines. Clearly consistent design and scale across four frames, restrained crisp low-resolution pixel-style, readable 32-pixel-style silhouettes expanded cleanly, no painterly microdetail. Friendly fantasy encounter creatures, not scary, no gore. No effects, weapons, text, labels, grid, floor, drop shadows, logo or watermark. Genuine transparent alpha background. Intended for short looping idle cycles and discrete windup/hurt states.
